dtsPropsFor.Hero:
/** Dotted meta row under the buttons — short mono strings, e.g. ["Engineering Manager @ Acme", "recife, br", "12 yrs shipping"]. Pass [] to drop the row entirely. */
  meta: string[];
dtsPropsFor.NavBar: /** NavBar takes no props — its section links and the theme toggle are baked in. */
dtsPropsFor.ThemeToggle:
/** Required — the toggle ships no styling of its own beyond its two labels. Pass the classes that place and size it (the nav uses a centred flex column with hover:bg-accent). */
  className: string;
